name: DRV claims from 60 points and 40 years, born 1 January 1964
workings: Born on 1 January 1964: each age is reached on 31 December, so the pension starts with January: 63 from January 2027, 67 (the standard age for 1964) from January 2031, 70 from January 2034
The 45-year pension isn't offered (40 < 45); growth assumptions set to 0
